Callout.Name: Fire in a Church
Callout.Message: Fire in the vestry of a church.
Callout.Advisory: Building being evacuated, no casualties reported.

Script.Line: It is in the vestry and the door was shut.
Everybody is out of the hall. We counted them out.
The organ pipes are against that wall and the wiring is ancient.

Lines.Approach: It is in the vestry and the building is old and dry. Get everybody out of the hall first.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
